questions: How many devices did you fabricate and measure with this layout, and how many showed coherent parity oscillations? The paper presents one device.
Why were the others set aside?
Which ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown, for example B|| values other than 150 mT, temperatures above base, and other dot orbitals or hybrid-segment Andreev states?
What does the second-best dataset look like where both parity manifolds were compared? Fig. ED9 is from an earlier cooldown without the odd-manifold check.

Matching even and odd frequencies is both your acceptance test for a tuning (Methods III) and a headline result: how many tunings did you try, how many passed, and what frequency differences did the rejected ones show?

At φ ≈ π in the main tuning, could you show the return probability versus pulse duration while detuning the outer dot and the inner dot of each chain, and fit λL and λR from Eqs. (23) to (25)? Fig. ED6i,j shows this only as pulsed charge-stability diagrams from the earlier cooldown.

For the odd manifold, how well does the parity-switching pulse map |eo⟩ and |oe⟩ onto the even manifold for readout, and how much of the 5% leakage in Fig. 2b comes from readout error and how much from parity switching?
Can you place your sweet spots relative to where Luethi et al. predict false poor man's Majoranas are common, for example with a microscopic model of the hybrid segments, or by adding a third site?
